input.body: We are writing to request a review of a $19.00 deduction on order DD-51131, dated 2026-11-06, which was issued with the reason "wrong item" for Chicken Momo (Steamed). The order ticket for DD-51131 lists 'Chicken Momo (Steamed)', which indicates the order was prepared as placed [DD-51131:ticket_lists_item]. Our records also show the order was ready at 19:31 and picked up at 19:34, three minutes later [DD-51131:pickup_handoff]. We recognise that these records show how the order was prepared and handed off, and they do not show the contents of the bag after pickup. Based on the ticket and the pickup timestamps, we ask that the deduction be reviewed and reversed. Thank you for your time and consideration.
